name: Keycap Nav
summary: A keyboard-first app menu: press G and keycaps rise out of every link, then a letter presses one down
about: A studio workspace menu built for the keyboard. Press G and a keycap springs up out of every menu item while a timer ring drains; press a letter and that cap clicks down, lights up and sends a ripple, the spacebar under the current item stretches across to its new home and the page heading types itself in. Brackets step between pages, J and K walk the inbox, the question mark opens a cheat sheet, and an on-screen key deck does all of it with a mouse or finger.
how: Press G, then H, P, I, C, R or S to jump to that page; Escape cancels.
Press [ or ] for the previous or next page, and ? for all shortcuts.
On Inbox, press J and K to move and Enter to mark a message read.
No keyboard? Tap the keys on the deck, or click the menu items.
A demo types shortcuts by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
